segments.name: IAM platform
segments.description: Provides multi-factor authentication and identity access management platforms, biometric services and hardware to enterprise, education and government customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Enterprise, education and government customers use the company's MFA, identity and biometric products to secure workforce and customer access.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers use BIO-key to (i) manage and secure work-related IT access of their employees, contractors and supply chain partners, which we call workforce identity; and (ii) manage and secure the identities of users of their web properties, which we call customer identity.
